_doc: Grudges and gratitude (RIV-001, Karma system). acts: hostile acts the player can commit against an NPC. Per act: name, days (time taken), fight (the NPC must be beaten first), requires_stronger (your realm must be above theirs), alignment (shift when done), grudge (added to the victim's grudge), kin_grudge (added for each living parent, child and spouse of the victim), failed_grudge (victim's grudge if you attack and lose), favor (victim's favor change), kills (the victim dies), loot_stones [min, max] spirit stones per (victim realm index + 1) plus everything they carry. max_grudge / max_gratitude cap the ledgers. decay_per_year: grudges fade by this much each year (gratitude does not). amends: stones_per_point (spirit stones per grudge point to make amends), min_cost. attitudes: {grudge, gratitude} each a list of [min_points, sentence] in ascending order; an NPC's Look text adds the sentence of the highest threshold their ledger value reaches ({name} = the NPC's name). Grudges are never held against the player by their own family, and children (younger than family.json adult_age) cannot be targeted. gratitude (RIV-001e): sources {kind: points} of gratitude earned per kind act (treat_npc: healing their injury, gift: giving them an item); favor_bonus_per_point: a grateful NPC's chat/gift favor gain is raised by gain x gratitude x this (still capped by family.json acquaintance limits); repay: each month an NPC owing at least min_gratitude has chance_per_month to send spirit stones (stones_per_realm [min, max] x their realm index + 1) plus one weighted gift ({weight, effects}, shared Effects keys, {} = stones only), spending cost gratitude.

grudge: {name} has sworn to see you dead.
gratitude: {name} owes you a debt of life.
